guard_bypass_reason: the six-call research cap starves per-wave selection calls; the raw driver keeps the runtime's production budgets but has no overlay
selector_accounting_caveat: selection-authority model calls are recorded in metrics.selection_authority but do not pass through the runtime's durable model-attempt ledger, so the runtime's own model budget does not count them
